en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from sahl Bin ZIyad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus who said,
‘I saw a blue pallium upon Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 11. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus who has said the following: “
I saw abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, wearing al-Taylisan (pallium) of blue color.’”
